blocks.text: Jab scientists kisi khayal ko test karna chahte hain to woh experiment ki dhyan se planning karte hain; is planning ko experimental design kehte hain. Woh tay karte hain ke kin par (subjects ya participants) experiment hoga, aur halaat ko control karte hain taa ke nataij munsifana (fair) hon. Phir woh sirf aik cheez badalte hain (independent variable) aur dekhte hain ke is se doosri cheez (dependent variable) par kya asar parta hai. Variables ka aapas mein taalluq dekh kar unhein pata chalta hai ke un ki hypothesis (andaza) sahih hai ya ghalat.
Kitab ne is section ko bhi '22.3' likha hai, halaanke 22.3 'Chart' pehle aa chuka hai; yeh asal mein 22.4 hona chahiye tha.
blocks.title: Kitab ka number

blocks.prompt: Bean (lobia) ke paudon ki growth par khaad (fertilizer) ke test mein independent aur dependent variable kya honge?
blocks.explanation: Independent variable: khaad ki miqdar (ya khaad dena / na dena), jo hum badalte hain. Dependent variable: paudon ki growth (maslan unchai), jo hum naapte hain.

items: Experimental design: experiment ki planning taa ke test munsifana ho.
Aik cheez badlein (independent variable), us ka asar naapein (dependent variable).
